sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing through an entire chain, so one absence cancels every subsequent step without explicit checks.
A weak reference automatically becomes nil when the object it points to is deallocated — the language zeroes out your hold on something the moment it ceases to exist elsewhere.
The Elvis operator ?: provides a fallback only when the left side is null — it's a syntax for what you settle for when what you wanted is gone.
